evidence_spans.snippet: The other four MSB bits of the address data are preset to '1001' by hard wiring inside the LM75A.
these pins represent the three LSB bits of the device 7-bit address.
At power-up, the Pointer value is equal to 0 and the Temp register is selected; users can then read the Temp data without specifying the pointer byte.
only 11 bits of those two bytes are used to store the Temp data in 2's complement format with the resolution of 0.125 °C.
only the 11 significant bits should be used, and the 5 LSB bits of the LS byte are zero and should be ignored.
